bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · SAR 转空，跌破 $281

read.en: Alphabet fell 1.2% on Nov 17 to $280.20, trading $278.46–284.09. It is below the 5-day ($290.4), 10-day ($288.4), 30-day ($314.2), 100-day ($337.3) and 200-day ($337.9); the 30, 100 and 200-day are falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram small; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 17 ($304.97), and RSI is 32.9.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月17日下跌 1.2%，收于 $280.20，盘中区间 $278.46–284.09。股价位于 5 日（$290.4）、10 日（$288.4）、30 日（$314.2）、100 日（$337.3）和 200 日均线（$337.9）下方；30、100 和 200 日均线均在下行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图较小；抛物线 SAR 于 11月17日转为看空（$304.97），RSI 为 32.9。

read.en: The drop broke the $280.6–283 support (Nov 5 close, Nov 16 low), now resistance, and flipped the SAR; the close sits on the Nov 3 close ($280.03). Resistance is $282.6–284.1, then $287.4–288.4 (Nov 10 close, 10-day) and $290.4–294.1 (5-day, Nov 16 high). Support is $276.9–278.5 (Oct 30, Nov 5 and Nov 17 lows), then $272.1 (52-week low, Mar 30). A close above $284.1 would target $287–288; below $276.9, $272.1.

r.en: Nov 5 close $282.57; Nov 16 low $282.96, lost; Nov 17 high $284.09
